Parliament's Monsoon Session Remains Open After 100 Days

Parliament's Monsoon Session has remained open for a record 101 days, exceeding 100 days since its adjournment sine die. This extended duration is the longest in the history of Parliament. Speculation exists regarding a delimitation bill and its potential impact on the approaching Winter Session, with uncertainty persisting over the dates for the Winter Session.
